configurations.// crosstabs-dev: DEFAULT (listed first) because it has no external dependencies -- just the local .venv. Flask dev server with auto-reload, so template/CSS/Python edits apply immediately. Serves the page, the session upload, and all API routes. Cannot do a real crosstab run or the streamed Decipher login: that needs Playwright's Chromium plus xvfb/x11vnc/novnc, which only exist in the Docker image. Use crosstabs-docker for those.
configurations.name: crosstabs-dev

configurations.// crosstabs-docker: Full app: Playwright Chromium for real runs, and xvfb/x11vnc/novnc for the streamed Decipher login. REQUIRES the Docker daemon to be running -- preview_start fails outright if Docker Desktop is not up. Code is baked into the image, so rebuild to pick up edits: docker build -t ghcr.io/itayole/crosstabs-portal:latest .
configurations.name: crosstabs-docker
